name: Upscale Image
description: Upscales images in the input directory by a specified factor.

inputs.name: Input Directory
inputs.description: Directory containing images to upscale (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP).

inputs.name: Scale Factor
inputs.description: Factor by which to upscale images (e.g., 2.0 for 2x upscale).

outputs.name: Output Directory
outputs.description: Directory where upscaled images will be saved.
